name: Flurazepam
metabolism: Rapidly metabolized, producing long-lived N-desalkylflurazepam and hydroxyethyl derivatives. Urinary elimination is mainly through conjugated metabolites rather than unchanged flurazepam.
summary: Flurazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative with anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, hypnotic, sedative, and muscle-relaxant properties. It produces a long-lived metabolite that may remain in the bloodstream for days.
